competency_text: Function of surveillance competencies ensure recognition of the function of laboratory testing in surveillance.
beginner: Describes the importance of health laboratory surveillance testing
competent: Explains the integration of health laboratory testing into broader surveillance programs
proficient: Ensures selected laboratory testing and reporting procedures are aligned with surveillance activities and program requirements
expert: Oversees the policies  processes and procedures that ensure laboratory data will support surveillance activity and program requirements

competency_text: Notification rules and protocols competencies ensure compliance with national and jurisdictional protocols or regulations regarding notifiable results.
beginner: Describes notification protocols or regulations
competent: Reports data to laboratory management
proficient: Manages the approval and communication of health surveillance test results
expert: Contributes to determination of national  regional  and local notification conditions

competency_text: Surveillance testing competencies ensure performance of surveillance testing.
beginner: Describes test sample collection  storage and analytical requirements
competent: Identifies the functional requirements of surveillance testing protocols*
proficient: Creates surveillance testing protocols that include functional requirements
expert: Directs development and modifications to surveillance testing systems based on jurisdictional guidance and analytical capabilities

competency_text: Surveillance testing competencies ensure performance of surveillance testing.
beginner: Describes test sample collection  storage  and analytical method workflows
competent: Employs established testing workflow and test methods for the surveillance target requirements
proficient: Customizes testing workflow policies and procedures to the surveillance target requirements
expert: Directs development and modifications to surveillance testing system workflows

competency_text: Surveillance testing competencies ensure performance of surveillance testing.
beginner: Tests samples for surveillance
competent: Participates in performance evaluation of surveillance test methods and testing capabilities
proficient: Applies technical knowledge to develop test methods and testing capabilities used in surveillance
expert: Oversees the selection and creation of health surveillance tests

competency_text: Surveillance testing competencies ensure performance of surveillance testing.
beginner: Describes at least one definition of an outbreak or exposure event
competent: Informs supervisor of potential outbreak or exposure event
proficient: Reports potential outbreak or exposure events to key stakeholders
expert: Contributes to the modification of outbreak or exposure event recognition processes or definitions

competency_text: Surveillance testing competencies ensure performance of surveillance testing.
subcompetency_text: Sample collection for outbreak or exposure events
beginner: Receives outbreak or exposure event samples for testing
competent: Ensures that outbreak or exposure event samples meet sample collection criteria
proficient: Collaborates with key stakeholders to determine the best samples to collect
expert: Contributes to sample collection guidelines for outbreak or exposure event scenarios

competency_text: Surveillance testing competencies ensure performance of surveillance testing.

competent: Ensures that outbreak or exposure event samples are prioritized according to schema
proficient: Reports outbreak or exposure event testing results to key stakeholders
expert: Represents the laboratory in After Action Reviews for outbreak or exposure events

competency_text: Response to critical surveillance event competencies ensure appropriate responses to critical surveillance events.
beginner: Describes critical event response processes and procedures related to surveillance
competent: Applies critical event processes and procedures related to surveillance
proficient: Evaluates plans and After-Action Review findings following critical events
expert: Modifies the policies  processes and procedures for critical surveillance events based on results of exercises or actual events

competency_text: Response to critical surveillance event competencies ensure appropriate responses to critical surveillance events.
beginner: Describes own critical event response duties related to surveillance
competent: Manages resources required to respond to critical events
proficient: Implements the critical event response plan
expert: Oversees the activation and termination of the critical event response plan

competency_text: Response to critical surveillance event competencies ensure appropriate responses to critical surveillance events.
beginner: Describes the need to coordinate testing priorities
competent: Communicates testing priorities to staff and laboratory management
proficient: Coordinates testing activities during critical events to align with identified testing priorities
expert: Ensures implementation of response plans during critical events

competency_text: Response to critical surveillance event competencies ensure appropriate responses to critical surveillance events.
beginner: Identifies when current testing capabilities do not exist to test an analyte or organism
competent: Applies technical knowledge to implement new testing capabilities
proficient: Develops plans to address testing capabilities for a specific new organism or analyte during critical surveillance events
expert: Determines the overall strategy for development of new testing capabilities during critical surveillance events

competent: Communicates the required demographic information to submitters
proficient: Ensures submission of crucial demographic information by submitters
expert: Determines demographic information fields required in informatics systems  requisition forms and reports

competent: Monitors the capture of sample information
proficient: Ensures collection of sample information
expert: Determines policies  processes and procedures for sample information collection based on jurisdictional requirements and guidelines

competency_text: Data analysis competencies ensure analysis of data from surveillance testing systems.

competent: Analyses laboratory surveillance data
proficient: Interprets laboratory surveillance data
expert: Develops standards for data analysis and for interpretation of laboratory surveillance data

proficient: Develops secure and stable data storage and retrieval systems  including creating new variables as necessary to support analysis of data
